description: List the business roles of an app's project, as { roles: [{ key, label }] }. Roles are what board policies (set_board_policy) name in their `roles` lists; they are separate from the app access role (viewer, editor, submitter) of add_app_user. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: list_app_roles
